review.note: A3/A6: the article's own part_of is Colonization of Angola (Q5148448), which this atlas does not hold and which carries no P580, P582 or P585, so the import had nothing to file it under. It is filed under the umbrella the atlas does hold whose span and subject fit: "Angolan Wars" at revision 1370826485 calls itself the conflicts in Angola involving Portugal and the Kingdom of Ndongo "from 1579 to 1683", and this battle names those two belligerents on 1583-02-02.

title: Battle of Talandongo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Talandongo", at revision 1370590437, opens: "The Battle of Talandongo was a military conflict between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Kingdom of Ndongo." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q130485022, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1583 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
